scope: Backlog gates B-01 (checkpoints 1-4) for win-cpu and win-cuda and B-06 (CUDA preflight and module 17 device comparison) for win-cuda, run by the owner on one Windows 11 machine with run_windows_gates.py, a review harness. Evidence for the specification, not product qualification. wsl-cuda, the other required CUDA pairs and the product-produced reference snapshot are not covered.

steps.check: GPU query line has four fields
a compiled sm_ architecture with the same major and minor <= device

device_comparison.note: Review-harness runs of module 17's 40-update adapter_train (AMD-049 preset, seed 17) on CPU and GPU on the same machine. This is not the product-produced device-comparison-reference-v1 snapshot that DEL-002 requires.

cpu_cross_platform_observation.note: Windows CPU run (12 threads) against the review sandbox's WSL CPU run (10 threads) of the same settings.
